name: aa
description: Add Anything - an instant global memo pad: $aa <memo>, $aa ld [keyword], $aa rm <id>. Shares ~/.aa/memos.jsonl with Claude Code and Kiro CLI.

interface.longDescription: Save a memo with $aa <text>, find and copy one with $aa ld [keyword], delete one with $aa rm <id>. Memos live in ~/.aa/memos.jsonl and are shared with the aa mod for Claude Code and the aa command.
